meta.name: Last Seen
meta.description: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

videos.title: The Dispatcher
videos.overview: A storm in the sleepy town of Port McKenna reveals a long-buried clue about a missing girl.

videos.title: The Call
videos.overview: Convinced he can flush out Maggie's kidnapper, Ian forms a plan.

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: A closer examination of the call turns Ian's world inside out.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Pressure mounts and relationships are tested as Ian leads the police to Henry and Jenna’s door.

videos.title: The Prophet
videos.overview: Henry and Jenna’s past holds the key to Maggie’s disappearance.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: An explosive confrontation between Ian and Henry leaves Sarah at a crossroads.
